A6_scope_expansion.message: Refused: UNAPPROVED_SCOPE_EXPANSION. The surface holds no authority the contract does not already grant. A material change needs the §1.3 amendment process — exact clause, impact analysis, owner approval, new version, TerminusDB commit, recompiled gates, revalidation.

A6_requirement_weakening.message: Refused: UNAPPROVED_SCOPE_EXPANSION. The surface holds no authority the contract does not already grant. A material change needs the §1.3 amendment process — exact clause, impact analysis, owner approval, new version, TerminusDB commit, recompiled gates, revalidation.

A7_gate_bypass.message: Refused: the surface cannot bypass a gate or self-approve. The gate is still required. CI performs the merge and the implementing agent does not self-certify (contract §21.2).

A7_self_approve.message: Refused: the surface cannot bypass a gate or self-approve. The gate is still required. CI performs the merge and the implementing agent does not self-certify (contract §21.2).

A8_sealed_repo.message: Refused: 'sealed holdout' is sealed-side. The builder submits candidates and receives verdict shapes; it never reads protected content (contract §17.2).

A8_protected_store.message: Refused: 'terminusdb_protected' is sealed-side. The builder submits candidates and receives verdict shapes; it never reads protected content (contract §17.2).

stale_contract_version.message: Refused: command is bound to contract 1.0, the governing version is 1.1.
